display.name: GCP Cloud SQL for MySQL Overview
display.description: GCP Cloud SQL for MySQL Overview dashboard

display.name: project_id
display.description: GCP Project ID

display.name: database_id
display.description: Database ID for instance

display.name: Queries
display.description: Statements executed by the server, per second.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: DML operations
display.description: MySQL DML operations per second, by operation type.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Disk Write IOPS
display.description: Data disk write IO operations per second.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Disk Read IOPS
display.description: Data disk read IO operations per second.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Connections
display.description: Number of connections to databases on the Cloud SQL instance.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Replication lag
display.description: Seconds the read replica is behind its primary. A negative value means replication is inactive.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Instance state
display.description: Current serving state of the Cloud SQL instance. One of ["RUNNING", "SUSPENDED", "RUNNABLE", "PENDING_CREATE", "MAINTENANCE", "FAILED" or "UNKNOWN_STATE"].

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: InnoDB row lock waits
display.description: Operations on InnoDB tables that had to wait for a row lock, per second.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Memory utilization
display.description: Fraction of the memory quota currently in use, shown as a percentage.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: CPU utilization
display.description: Percentage of reserved CPU currently in use.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Server up
display.description: Whether the MySQL server is up (1) or down (0). A value of 0 indicates an outage.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: InnoDB deadlocks
display.description: InnoDB deadlocks, counted per step.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Disk utilization
display.description: Fraction of the disk quota currently in use, shown as a percentage.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Slow queries
display.description: Queries taking longer than long_query_time, per second.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Aborted connects
display.description: Failed attempts to connect to the MySQL server, counted per step.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: InnoDB buffer pool miss ratio
display.description: Percentage of logical reads that InnoDB could not satisfy from the buffer pool and had to read from disk. High values indicate memory pressure.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'
project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'

display.name: Threads
display.description: MySQL threads by kind: cached, connected, and running.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND database_id in $database_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'cloudsql_database'
